findings.reproduction: POST compile with: “Create an alert for 5 minutes when a car stays in Service Bay A”; “When a car enters Service Bay A with hood and trunk open, create an alert”; “When 3 or more or 5 or more cars are in Service Bay A, create an alert”.
findings.expected: Reject unsupported action duration, multiple conditions and multiple comparisons without changing intent.
findings.actual: All return HTTP 200 and ok=true. Alert duration becomes dwell ≥300 seconds; hood-and-trunk becomes trunk-only; two comparisons become threshold 2. A bare “with hood” also disappears into a geometric rule.
findings.fix: Delimit trigger clauses in both action orders and validate the action tail. Consume only matched condition spans, count inclusive suffix comparisons, and reject remaining semantic terms.

findings.reproduction: Against owned loopback TCP, delay getaddrinfo 250 ms with a 100 ms deadline; separately delay resolution 160 ms before a stalled real TLS handshake with a 200 ms deadline. Repeat a 250 ms production admission delay under a 100 ms deadline.
findings.expected: One deadline bounds resolution, approval and all transport phases. Socket/SSL failures return classified non-confirming results.
findings.actual: DNS takes 250.9 ms, admission 251.0 ms, and TLS 369.9 ms. TLS raises uncaught TimeoutError. Late POSTs are prevented, but workers and permits remain occupied beyond expiry. A configured 40 ms read timeout is ignored until the 500 ms overall deadline; connection refusal also escapes the adapter.
findings.fix: Bound resolution and approval lookup; recompute remaining time before TLS and every blocking phase; honor phase limits and normalize socket/SSL errors. Retain capacity until any remaining underlying work terminates.

findings.reproduction: Budget 1, three distinct supported-size 4 MiB fixture images, 120 ms deadline. Owned TCP server reads the first 8 KiB of each POST and stalls, causing actual sendall timeouts.
findings.expected: Started writes consume attempts even when partially unsuccessful; budget 1 prevents subsequent sends.
findings.actual: Three connections each receive 8,192 bytes, while outbound_attempts=0, completed=0 and the shared budget remains empty. Accounting happens only after successful sendall.
findings.fix: Charge the admitted attempt after final approval/expiry checks and before invoking sendall. Do not refund indeterminate partial failures. Preserve zero accounting for genuine preflight, revoked and expired-before-write cases.

findings.reproduction: Send a positive JSON envelope over owned TCP, then close before declared Content-Length, omit the terminal chunk from a chunked response, or declare Content-Length: garbage. Exercise provider → router → event → action.
findings.expected: Malformed or incomplete HTTP responses remain non-confirming transport failures.
findings.actual: All three fixtures produce visual_status=ok, action_status=done and one persisted notification each. Premature EOF returns partial bodies as success; invalid length becomes zero.
findings.fix: Validate framing before constructing a successful response: valid unambiguous length, exact completion, chunk boundaries/CRLF and terminating chunk/trailers. Reject malformed framing and premature EOF.
